verdict.rationale: monday.com is a work-management product, so subtasks and task dependencies are a fair question for it. However, no first-party evidence in the pack documents subtasks, dependency links or blocking order. The only related item is a community complaint that ticket linking is "really bad" and loses data, which shows neither subtask breakdown nor dependency ordering.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear
